text: Based on the tool output, there is evidence of tree-cover loss in 2025 within the asset, with an area of 13.5 hectares. The JRC dataset corroborates that 98% of this area was mapped as forest in 2020. Furthermore, the MGAP forest map indicates that 13.1 hectares of this loss occurred in native forest. Therefore, it can be concluded that native forest was deforested in this area in 2025.
